newsitem.title: USA: Clinton budget has $98 bln tax cuts over 5 years.
newsitem.headline: Clinton budget has $98 bln tax cuts over 5 years.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will propose tax cuts costing $98.4 billion between 1998 and 2002 in his budget, according to a summary of the budget obtained by reporters late on Wednesday.
The cuts will be offset by closing tax loopholes worth $34.3 billion over the same period.

The budget, to be released officially on Thursday, also expects $36.1 billion will be raised from the auction of broadcasting rights and expects to raise $41.7 billion from other sources such as renewed excise taxes and other user fees.
